title: 'Phite Club
start: Talk to Hassan in the Menaphos Merchant district.

recommended.t: Beast of Burden familiar for extra food or Combat Summoning familiar
Skill boosting potions (e.g. grand magic potion or super magic potion if you're planning to use magic for the battle)
Emergency teleport (e.g. Merchant district teleport tablet)

rewards.t: Access from Sophanem to Menaphos via the bridge between the two
Relic of Tumeken, giving 15,000 base reputation with a faction in Menaphos of your choice

steps.t: Speak with Grand Vizier Hassan in the Merchant district of Menaphos. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Phite Club. › Accept › Any › 2 I'll help if I get to end him.]
p: Osman reveals he now has proof of his lineage

steps.t: Speak to the faction heads, preferably ending with worker (closest to tomb)

sub.t: Speak to Grand Vizier Ehsan (Merchant) also in the same building. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Phite Club. › Any]
Speak to 'Admiral' Wadud (Ports) in the Golden Scarab Inn in the Port district. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Phite Club. › Any]
Speak to Commander Akhomet (Imperial) in the Imperial district. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Phite Club.]
Speak to Batal (Worker) in the Worker district. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Phite Club.]

steps.t: Enter the Shifting Tombs and speak to Ozan inside.
Exit the Shifting Tombs and use the mask you received from Ozan with the bucket of blood next to the fish stall in the Merchant district.
Speak to Akhomet in the Imperial district. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Phite Club.]
Give the signets to Batal in the Worker district. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Phite Club.]
Give the certificate to Wadud in the Port district.  [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Phite Club.]
Speak to Ehsan in the Merchant district. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Phite Club.]
Speak to Hassan in the Merchant district. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Phite Club. › 1 Yes, let's go confront the Pharaoh.]
Kill four level 105 Menaphos palace guards. This will be a checkpoint for the final fight.

sub.t: Use Protect from Magic prayer and finish off the ones using melee combat style first.
"Kneel" or "Usurpers!" - Use the freedom ability to break free and prevent further damage.
Move off the green fire as soon as it spawns.

p: Amascut damages the Soul Altar and kills Jabari
